evals.prompt: In `otel-demo`, we run Rust `shipping` (`:8080`, calling PHP `quote`) and C++ `currency` (`:8080`). Can we use OpenTelemetry Operator initContainer auto-instrumentation on `shipping` and `currency`? evals.expected_output: Explains that Rust (`shipping`) and C++ (`currency`) do NOT support Operator webhook initContainer auto-instrumentation; runs `scripts/render_obi_manifest.py` to generate a least-privilege **OpenTelemetry eBPF Instrumentation (`OBI`)** DaemonSet (`ghcr.io/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-ebpf-instrumentation/obi`, Linux kernel `>= 5.8` BTF `/sys/kernel/btf/vmlinux`, `BPF`/`PERFMON` capabilities without `privileged: true`, `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://opentelemetry-otel-collector.otel-demo.svc.cluster.local:4317`), and provides manual SDK Downward API `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` (`service.namespace=otel-demo`, `k8s.pod.name`, `k8s.namespace.name`, `k8s.pod.uid`, `k8s.node.name`) + W3C `tracecontext` guidance.
expectations: States clearly that Rust (`shipping`) and C++ (`currency`) cannot use Operator initContainer auto-instrumentation
Renders a least-privilege `OBI` eBPF `DaemonSet` + read-only `ClusterRole` targeting `http://opentelemetry-otel-collector.otel-demo.svc.cluster.local:4317` and notes Linux `>= 5.8` BTF prerequisites
Includes manual SDK Downward API `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` (`service.namespace=otel-demo`) and W3C `tracecontext` propagation guidance

evals.prompt: After migrating our C#/.NET `cart` service in `otel-demo` to an Alpine base image (`mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:8.0-alpine`) and adding `instrumentation.opentelemetry.io/inject-dotnet: "true"`, the `cart` pod crashes immediately at startup with `Error loading shared library ld-linux-x86-64.so.2`. expectations: Pinpoints glibc (`linux-x64`) vs Alpine musl (`linux-musl-x64`) CLR profiler library mismatch on `cart`
Previews setting `dotnet_runtime: "linux-musl-x64"` on `Deployment/cart` in `otel-demo` via `otel_manage_workload_instrumentation(..., dry_run=True)`

evals.prompt:
Lint this `ad` service Deployment YAML in `otel-demo` before we enable Java auto-instrumentation:
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: ad
  namespace: otel-demo
spec:
  template:
    metadata:
      annotations:
        resource.opentelemetry.io/service.namespace: otel-demo
        instrumentation.opentelemetry.io/inject-java: "true"
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: ad
          image: ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.2.0-ad

```

expectations: Detects `readOnlyRootFilesystem: true` without a `/tmp` `volumeMount` on `Deployment/ad`
Explains why JVM `javaagent.jar` extraction/attach needs a writable `/tmp` `emptyDir`
Provides the exact `volumes` + `volumeMounts` `/tmp` `emptyDir` patch for `ad`
